title: Continuity of the standard Gaussian density
statement: The standard Gaussian density $\varphi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, given by $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$, is continuous on $\mathbb R$.
replaced: The standard Gaussian density $\varphi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, defined by $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$, is continuous on $\mathbb R$.
